# hr-style

- ID: `MD035`
- Category: Whitespace and layout
- Default: on, severity warning
- Fixable: yes
- Tags: `hr`

Every horizontal rule is written the same way as the first one, such as ---.

## Why

One way of writing horizontal rules makes them easy to recognize in the source.
Indentation and trailing spaces do not count.

## Options

Set them under `rules.hr-style.options`.

- `style` (`string`, default `consistent`): Horizontal rule to require, such as
  ---. consistent takes the style of the first one.

## Fix

The fix rewrites each horizontal rule in the expected style. gomdlint reports
some horizontal rules without a fix, such as one whose change would turn the
line above it into a heading. gomdlint may report a finding without a fix when
the fix would change a line with one character in brackets, such as \[x\] or
\[1\], or the lines around it up to a blank line, because it could add or remove
a task list checkbox.

## Configure

```yaml
rules:
  hr-style:
    options:
      style: consistent
```

Under `rules`, `hr-style: false` turns the rule off and `hr-style: error`
reports its findings as errors. The flag `--disable hr-style` turns it off for
one run.

## Silence one line

```markdown
<!-- markdownlint-disable-next-line hr-style -->
```
